one_liner: Anneal on premium data, extend RoPE context to 8192, and inject math/code capability across one continuous LR decay.

key_terms.definition: The phase between pretraining and post-training that resumes from a pre-decay checkpoint to run quality annealing, context extension, and capability injection, still via self-supervised next-token prediction.
LR schedule with warmup, a long constant-LR stable phase, then a short sharp decay; mid-training resumes at the plateau and runs the decay leg over upgraded data.
Feeding a higher-quality, denser data mix specifically during the WSD decay window, since that window is where most committed loss reduction happens.
Raising the RoPE frequency base theta by s^(d/(d-2)) so positions up to a new longer length map onto the same angular range the model learned at the shorter pretrain length.
A refinement of RoPE context extension that scales each wavelength individually and adds an attention-temperature correction for the entropy growth of longer-context attention.
Attention layers, placed every 4th layer in Stack-100M, that carry no positional encoding at all and therefore need no rescaling when extending context length.
Concentrating narrow, targeted data (math, code) into the final low-LR sub-phase to give the model a specific capability floor without pulling it far off its general manifold.
A long-context validation probe that plants a unique fact at a random depth in a long document and checks whether the model can recover it via next-token completion.
Binning per-token loss by its position within the context window to reveal whether a model genuinely uses distant tokens, since scalar average perplexity can hide a broken tail.
An attention variant where multiple query heads share a small number of key/value heads, shrinking the KV cache and helping longer contexts fit in memory.
